_about: Drow City (levels 1-28): dark elves who answer each other's call, driders, the weaponsmasters, masters and Matron Mothers as elites, the yochlol on the Bloodstained Dais and the Matron Mother of the city's heart as sub-bosses, and the High Priestess of Lloth in the Grand Temple, poisoning the floor and calling her driders.

51200.name: high priestess lloth
51200.long_desc: The High Priestess of Lloth stands before the spider altar, her snake-headed whip coiling at her feet.
51200.description: Tall, silver-haired and terrible, in a gown of black spider-silk set with rubies. The five snakes of her whip hiss in turn; she speaks for the Spider Queen, and the whole city trembles when she is displeased.

phases.message: The High Priestess shrieks: "Lloth, Queen of Spiders, devour them!"

abilities.name: Lloth's Wrath
abilities.telegraph: The High Priestess raises her arms to the spider idol!

abilities.name: Serpent Whip
abilities.telegraph: The High Priestess cracks her snake-headed whip at you!

abilities.name: Unholy Word
abilities.telegraph: The High Priestess begins to speak a word of power!

791051.name: drow patrol warrior
791051.long_desc: A drow patrol warrior moves silently through the dark streets.
791051.description: A slender dark elf in black mail, a hand crossbow at the hip and a short sword in hand. The patrols kill outsiders on sight.
